batting.name: KK Cooper
batting.dismissal: c R Shukla b JP Duminy

batting.name: SV Samson
batting.dismissal: c KM Jadhav b Imran Tahir

batting.name: STR Binny
batting.dismissal: st KD Karthik b Imran Tahir

batting.name: MA Agarwal
batting.dismissal: c SPD Smith b JP Faulkner

batting.name: KD Karthik
batting.dismissal: c BCJ Cutting b DS Kulkarni

batting.name: JP Duminy
batting.dismissal: c KK Nair b PV Tambe

batting.name: R Shukla
batting.dismissal: c SPD Smith b KK Cooper

balls.text: he gets a free run-out wicket! faulkner swings at the length ball, gets a bottom edge back to the bowler, but Cutting is half-way down the pitch and sees no reason to return
second tier gets themselves on big screen as the ball lands into them! Full delivery, whacked over long on to bring the team's 200
that's one step towards 200! Shukla bowls a half-volley and Faulkner loves it, smashes it over wide long-on. Keep them coming
he misses out again! This is a full toss on the pads, should have gone to Ahmedabad city centre, but it goes towards cover after hitting the pads.. Cutting is cutting a sorry figure in this over
now he beats the inside edge as Cutting aims for the crowd again, it came in a touch after pitching
swings and misses as this doesn't bounce much, it misses the off stump too
high full toss, this is called a no-ball straight away.. Faulkner picks a single with a whip to square leg, doesn't get any distance on that
shorter and flatter now, the batsman punches it to deep extra cover for a single to make it 17 off the over
tossed up, now Faulkner joins in.. He goes down on his knee and swings across the line.. The spin doesn't matter, this is into the crowd at deep midwicket
bowls a slower one outside off, Cutting slaps it down to long-on

Cutting cuts loose! This is outta here! Slow and spinning from outside leg stump towards the middle but short enough for Cutting to get under it.. That is one monster pull over deep midwicket, it's gone over the roof.. 101 meter hit
slower on the stumps, the batsman can only pick a single to cover
bowls some slow leg spin on the pads, Faulkner punches it to wide long-off for a quick couple
big legspinner, the batsman drags it down the ground off the toe off his bat, Jadhav runs in from long-on and takes a simple catch. This has been a superb over from Tahir
it's the flipper now, skids on to the batsman who was shaping to pull it, hits him on the thigh pad
picks up a single as the fielder at point fails to stop the cut cleanly
Binny comes and Binny goes! They are checking with the third umpire but it's out to the naked eye. Binny charges down the pitch, gets comprehensively beaten by the googly and is well short
looks to cart it through cover, but doesn't get any timing, picks up a single to cover
bowls a quicker delivery on the stumps, Samson is hurried by that and inside edges it to his pads
he comes round the wicket and bowls the arm-ball, Binny misses his flick and gets hit on the pads
that's hit the top of middle and stump! Rahane has gone too far down the leg to make room and this one spins to beat his bat-swing
comes out of the crease and punches the tossed up delivery to long off for a single
another low full toss, this time it's driven straight to long on
low full toss is hardly going to test a batsman, not Rahane certainly! He thwacks it over wide long-on and into the crowd
fires it on the base of offstump, the batsman toe-ends it to deep extra cover
fires this wide down the leg side from over the wicket

what has Kaul done! He ran from fine-leg towards deep backward square leg and made it in time to cut it off, but as he slid on his knees, he slid all the way across, the ball comes later after he has gone to the other side and reaches the boundary. Not a great ball too - a full toss, it was asking to be hit
shuffles across to the off and clips the length delivery to deep backward square leg for a couple
another one to the fine-leg boundary! Rahane gets his fifty with a kind-of paddle from off and middle. He was almost beaten by the slowness of it, but manages to show it the right direction
he hits the pads with a full toss and appeals, but this was heading down the leg side.. Samson should be disappointed he missed out on that
it's a very good ball, a slower yorker on the pads, but it's equally well-played as Samson flicks it fine down the leg side, beats the short fine leg fielder to the boundary
he wanted to smash this slower delivery out over long-on, but can only manage a thick outside edge fine on the off side, third man cuts it off
length delivery on off, now Rahane punches it with some flourish, but straight to long off
length delivery, this is powered to deep extra cover

that is brilliantly played! This is short delivery outside off, the batsman plays a fore-hand topspinner down the ground.. This was played from shoulder level.. Over the boundary towards the sight screen
short of length delivery on off, this was punched straight to extra cover but Nadeem allows it to slip through his legs, gives away an easy single
it's a Samson special! how quick is he to spot the length! It's outside off and he swings it beautifully over long-off, just a clean golf swing
back of length delivery on off, the batsman whips it to deep midwicket
superbly picks the gap at cover! The fielder in the deep are all too straight - there is one at deep extra cover and another at long-off, so the batsman places his cut shot square and no one moves
he comes out of the crease but realises he is not to the pitch of the ball, looks to defend but gets an inside edge to the leg side
this is full enough for Samson to drive it firmly down to long-off
it;s the legspinner this time, Rahane allows it to turn, then chips it to wide long-on
it's the googly and it's short enough for the batsman to drag it down to deep backward square leg
short ball to start with, but Rahane picks the man at deep midwicket with his pull, just a single
waits on the back foot and chops it to backward point
he moves to the leg and looks to hammer it over long-off, but doesn't get the timing.. it drops a few paces short of the fielder
fires it across the batsman, this is a bit too wide outside off, umpire not impressed
quicker delivery on the stumps, the batsman punches it down to long off
pushes it through on the legs with a round-arm action, the batsman clips it straight to short fine leg
another short one, this one is pulled in front of the wicket, to deep midwicket
short and quick on the body, the batsman is hurried into his pull but manages to drag it to deep square leg
excellent placement, Rahane backs away and slaps it through extra cover, sweeper and long off converge, but it just beats them into the rope
gets away with one that sits up outside off from a good length, Samson waits and thumps it straight to the sweeper
leaves the crease again, but Tiwary's not given this one as much flight, and it's also pitched well short of Samson, he defends
tosses it up again, this is around off, Samson comes out immediately, and deposits it over the straight boundary
tosses it up on the pad, it is nudged to midwicket
pushed off the front foot to point
sees it pitching on a length outside off and backs away to cut, but cannot time the shot, chops it away for a single to the sweeper
pushes a full toss back to the bowler, who cannot stop it, and concedes the single
forward to a tossed up ball from over the wicket and drives it down the ground
turned to deep midwicket for a single
he's gone now, but he's done his job, Duminy angles it wide across him, Cooper stretches to have a swat at it, it is another high mishit, and sweeper cover settles under it

Cooper's hit another six, didn't look like going all the way as he hit it, it was a pitched up delivery, and Cooper swung it straight, went high, remained in the air for a while and eventually cleared the boundary comfortably
sprays it way outside off from round the stumps
some turn now, it beats the outside edge as Rahane looks to turn it to midwicket
pushes it through down the leg side, Nadeem is not impressed with that call.. It was off the pad
slower and tossed up on off, how well has he timed this! He comes on the front foot and carts it along the ground to the cover boundary.. The fielder was too straight there
he moves way down the leg side and drives the fuller delivery along the ground to long off
pushed through on the stumps, he dabs it towards deep midwicket for a single
tossed up on leg stump, Cooper drives it hard past the bowler
pushed through on the pads, Rahane looks to flick it but it grazes is pad to short fine leg
swing and a miss! This spins past the outside edge and beats him
bowls this slightly short, Rahane rocks back and slaps it to deep midwicket
now looks to punch it through cover, but gets an inside edge past the stumps to short fine leg
this is the googly now, doesn't turn that much.. Cooper plays it smartly, doesn't try to hit it hard, just chips it over the bowler's head and gets a boundary
this is a proper legspinner and it turns too, takes the outside edge to run down to third-man boundary
big swing of the bat but he was playing for the legspin, this is a googly and cuts him in half
slower and loopy on off, Rahane defends it to cover point
makes room and blasts it through extra cover, but there is a fielder in the deep for that shot..
this is not timed at all, but Cooper sends it over long-off! The fielder was kept interested, this is just over him.
a touch on the leg side, easily dabbed to midwicket for a single
slower on off, Rahane looks to punch it through the gap at cover, but the fielder dives to cut it off
tossed up on the stumps, Rahane pushes it back in the air almost all the way to the bowler
quicker on the off, the batsman pushes it to wide long-on for a single
now goes for the long-handle shot, but luckily for him, doesn't time it.. It lands short of long-off
tossed up and not full enough, Cooper wants to swing it, but checks his drive to cover point
slightly shorter outside off, Rahane turns it to deep midwicket with his wrists
gets a googly which he didn't know about much, luckily this turns down the leg side and flicks the pads to run down fine.. Nadeem dives to save the boundary
tossed up delivery on the stumps, Rahane dabs it towards midwicket, looks for two, but is sent back in time
flatter and Cooper likes to swing! He bared his intentions in the first ball, this time he goes all the way.. Straight towards the sight screen
fuller and on the stumps, the batsman nudges it to square leg for a single
moves to the leg side and throws his bat straightaway, doesn't get any timing, but picks a  single to deep midwicket
that is plumb in front! This was the arm-ball and Nair plays down the wrong line, this would have knocked the middle and leg
fuller delivery on the stumps, pushed to mid-on for a single
pushed through on the pads, the batsman defends it to the leg side

another inside out drive! Karun is looking good here. This was fuller and slightly slower from Kaul and the batsman blasts it over extra cover. He doesn't get the distance but he would be happy with the result. Yes 6 is better than 4, but still a good result
he stays in the crease and dabs the back of length delivery towards midwicket for a quick single
back of length delivery, he waits and runs it down to third man
now he clips it past the midwicket fielder easily for a quick couple
this one is 100% Uthappa, in timing, in distance. It's a length ball and he picks it up beautifully over extra cover
this is just like Uthappa! He plants his front foot out and plays a smooth drive over the mid-off fielder with a very straight bat, picks up a couple as this wasn't timed as well as Uthappa
waits on the back foot and whips the back of length delivery to midwicket
back of length delivery on off, comes a touch slow off the pitch, punched to Tiwary at cover
big outside edge and the keeper and the gully fielder look at each other, perfectly bisected, like using those compasses in school geometry..
short and wide, he would think that he missed out, chops this one straight to third-man
he stays back and clips the back of length delivery to deep midwicket off his hips
back of length delivery on the stumps, Nair pushes it softly towards mid-on and calls for a quick one
good delivery in the channel, some away movement too. Rahane comes forward and lets it go through
crisply timed through point! He comes forward and pushes away from the body, but gets it off the middle of the bat
he goes wide of the crease and bowls it short of length, the batsman punches it straight to point
loose forward prod from Karun, he plays outside the line to this incoming delivery and inside edges it to his back pad
length delivery outside off, not much bounce on this pitch as the keeper takes it below his knees after the batsman lets it through
he leaps and bowls a length delivery on off, the batsman clips it straight to midwicket
beautifully driven! It's a half-volley on off but Rahane gently comes forward, leans on it and caresses it through extra cover
he stands tall and punches the back of length ball straight to cover
he comes forward and defends the length delivery to cover point
corrects his line and bowls this wide outside off, gets some away movement. Rahane lets it go through
this is superbly timed through midwicket! Rahane allows this to come in, then clips it in the air easily with the turn of wrists.. it races away
not a good start, this is heading down the leg side, clips the pads and runs down to the boundary
more flight and it's on the leg stump, Rahane picks up another single to deep midwicket
not too full this time, Rahane comes forward and defends
another loopy delivery on the stumps, again clipped to deep midwicket for a single
lots of air on this one, the batsman whips it to deep midwicket for a single
he gets some room and he takes full toll, cracking it off the back foot and finding the gap at point
he comes round the wicket and pushes it through on off, the batsman looks to punch it to off but chops it close to the stumps
bowls it wide outside off and the game is over
yorker length, the batsman punches it to deep midwicket and calls for a second.. Tiwary loses his bat at the other end
a low full toss on the pads, Tiwary takes some bonus runs, hoicking it over deep midwicket
fires this wide down the leg side
slower delivery, swung across the line to deep square leg.. There was a mix-up, but Binny's wild throws allows them to complete the second easily
comes back over the wicket, the batsman steers it to third man for a single
he comes round the wicket and fires it on the blockhole, the batsman digs it out to long on
meanwhile Tiwary gets to his half-century with a push to deep cover
slower ball outside off, Tiwary drags this to deep backward square leg boundary
wants to drag this one from outside off to the leg side, misses it completely
bowls a yorker, the batsman digs it out to cover
length delivery on off, the batsman pushes it to deep cover for a single
he gets a low full toss and he smashes it straight to extra cover, Smith takes an easy one
looks to play the reverse paddle but gets an underedge past keeper for another boundary
offcutter, the batsman pulls it down to deep backward square leg, reaches Cooper on the bouncer
this is almost a yorker, the batsman pushes it back to the bowler
low full toss, driven down to wide long-on for a single
length ball, swung over to deep midwicket for a single
another boundary! Cutting slides at wide long-off but is not able to stop that one.. Oh well, Cutting is turning out to be quite a mixed bag
short slower delivery, Tiwary picks up a boundary with a neat little steer through first slip region
a low full toss, this is powered down to long off
a yorker now, the batsman gets a bat to it and then it ends up to the right of the keeper. The batsman had no clue
swing and a miss, it bounces over the middle stump
a low full toss, this is hammered down the ground for a boundary
length delivery, the batsman charges out and smashes it back to the bowler, Cooper leaps up and gets both hands to it, but can't complete the catch
another yorker, the batsman pushes it to mid-off for a single
another slower bouncer, it bounces over the batsman's head like this was Roland Garros surface
fires in a yorker, the batsman digs it out to midwicket
slower bouncer, Tiwary looks to drag it to the leg side but takes a blow to his chest
length delivery on the stumps, defended from the crease
short ball on the body, the batsman looks to pull it fine, but gets a glove that drops just before the keeper.. They take a single as the keeper tries to rearrange himself
Kulkarni brings in some welcome pace, the batsman whips it to deep square leg easily
fuller one on off, the batsman wrists it to deep midwicket
fuller delivery on the pads, Shukla flicks and picks a single to deep square leg
Tahir walks all the way to the off side to play a ramp, Binny keeps it straight and simple and preys on Tahir's error.. The batsman misses and the ball smashes the off stick
length delivery on the stumps, pushes to midwicket
length delivery on the stumps, the batsman punches it to deep midwicket for a single
length delivery on off, the batsman dabs it straight to point
length ball, comes in towards off stump, the batsman defends
slower bouncer outside off, Tahir sways away from the line
this is not quite a yorker, a half-volley and Tahir creams it through the gap at cover
he is getting nice inswing in these yorkers, the batsman digs it out down the pitch
Cutting's day is following a sine wave! It's heading towards the crest now, this one is full and swinging, beats the bat and hits the leg stump
fires a yorker on the middle stump, the batsman gets an inside edge to his pads, it rolls over the off side and they take a single
tossed up outside off, the batsman paddles it to short fine leg
another slower slower ball, but this time Tiwary makes some momentum by coming out of the crease and hammers it long over the cow corner
the slower slower ball this one, the batsman looks to drag it to the on side, gets an inside edge down to short fine leg
another slower one outside off, the batsman cuts it straight to point
slower and on the pads, the batsman goes deep in the crease and flicks it to deep square leg
bowls length at a normal pace, the batsman comes out of the crease and pushes it straight to cover
fuller delivery on the stumps, the batsman digs it out to the bowler
fires it full on the off side, the batsman squeezes it to point where Karun misfields allowing a single

easy run-out! What a mixed day this is for Cutting! He bowls a slower one, the batsman pushes it to off, the non-striker charges down half-way, the striker stops, Cutting has all the time to take the aim at the non-striker's and he hits it direct..
slower delivery outside off, Tiwary waits and waits before cutting it late past the keeper for another boundary
length delivery again, but the batsman manages to swing across the line and gets it in the gap at wide long on
bowls length outside off, it stays low and slips under the bat
fuller delivery, he sweeps it to short fine leg for a quick single
flatter delivery, Jadhav comes out of the crease and chips it to long off
comes down the pitch and drags the slower one down to deep midwicket without much timing
drifts in to the pads, the batsman sweeps it firmly to deep backward square leg
tossed up outside off, the batsman pushes it to deep cover for a single
attempts a reverse sweep at one bowled down the leg side, hits it straight to short third man
fuller delivery outside off, the batsman drives it down to long on
drifting on to the leg side, the batsman goes down for a sweep and gets a faint tickle to run it down fine
another legcutter, the batsman pushes it to cover point
pushes the length ball straight to midwicket, but a wayward throw to the keeper from the fielder gives away an extra

one-hander from Bhatia! this is on a length and gets stuck in the pitch, Taylor punches it down the pitch but gets hit high on the bat, it lobs up softly towards the bowler who sticks his right-hand out and plucks it

Cutting is not sure if he has taken this catch or not!! He runs in from long-off to take this chipped shot.. But the replays show he didn't get his fingers under that.. Could have been a super catch..but it could be considered as a drop because he got there
this one is flatter and spins away, Tiwary drags it to deep midwicket
fires this one flat, but this is a big wide down the leg side, Samson has to dive to get to it
tossed up delivery outside off, 90 kph, Taylor nudges it behind point for a quick single
uses his feet and nudges the flatter delivery to deep square leg
fuller delivery on the pads, Taylor dabs it to midwicket for a single
he comes out of the crease and pushes the tossed up delivery down to long on
this stays low outside off, Tiwary pushes it to deep cover off the back foot
slips this down the leg side, another wide
almost a flighted delivery from a spinner, the batsman pushes it back down the pitch
length delivery on the pads, flicked to deep square leg for a single

this is falling apart very quickly! Bhatia does it now, this is a slower delivery at 96 kph, KP gives himself room and looks to go over extra cover, but this comes slow off the surface, stays low too, takes the inside edge and ruins the stump arrangement
this is too far down the leg side, easy call
keeps it accurate on the stumps, the batsman pushes it to long on
slower still, this time it is punched to deep cover
bowls a slow length ball on the stumps, KP punches it straight to extra cover
tossed up delivery on the stumps, Tiwary pushes it softly to deep midwicket and calls for a second
JP is not going to be the saviour! He looks to cut the quicker delivery but cannot keep it down, straight to point
how good is that! That was a low-trajectory ball and it looked like it was not going to be an easy one to get under.. But he smokes it over long on with flat hit
quicker one on the pads again, cramps him for room, the batsman pushes it through midwicket for a single
pushed through outside off, JP drives it to long off for a single
bowls it flat and quick on the leg stump, KP punches it to long on
he nudges the back of length delivery to square leg for a single
cracked to mid-off off the front-foot, does it too well and it reaches the fielder quickly, no chance of a single
atrocious ball! This is very very wide down the leg side
slower delivery outside off, the batsman guides it down to third man
back of length delivery on the stumps, JP nudges it to fine leg
looks to punch this length delivery off the front foot, but doesn't get the timing right, pushes it to cover
fires this on the middle and leg line, the batsman misses his flick and gets hit on the pads
length delivery on off, the batsman pushes it straight to cover off the back foot
bowls a length delivery across the left-hander, left alone
Cutting takes a catch at fine-leg! This time he settles under it nicely and gobbles it up.. Slower short ball, DK pulls it straight down to fine-leg
looks to pull the back of length delivery across the line, but gets a bottom edge to short fine leg
he comes forward and punches the length ball straight to mid-on
he walks across the stumps and gets hit on the pads, appeal for lbw.. and only the bowler is interested. This could have been close too
walks across the stumps and looks to whip it fine on the leg side but gets hit on the thigh pad
another quick single to midwicket as KP dabs it off the front foot
dabbed to midwicket for a quick single off the back foot
length delivery on the stumps, the batsman dabs it to point and Unmukt gets there quickly and fires a throw at non-striker's..
he clips it to short fine leg for a single and takes a quick single
length delivery on off, the batsman drops it to the off side
and he makes them pay straightaway, leans on the length ball and hammers it over mid-off

Unmukt runs in from point and hits the stumps direct, but KP makes it in time.. He is gone! Hello hello! He has not slid his bat in.. It gets stuck in the mud before the line.. It hasn't been referrred.. This is the repeat  of few matches ago when he was out and no one checked.. This is big big.. RR don't appeal for it... It happened the last time when DD played against Royals in Delhi.. KP is very lucky.. very very lucky
beautifully punched! He stands tall to this length ball and crunches it to wide mid-off where Smith makes the save
attempts the Uthappa straight loft over mid-off but fails, he doesn't get it off the middle and ends up chipping it towards mid-off where Smith back pedals to take a simple catch
looks to bisect the gap between short third man and point, but doesn't succeed, straight to the fielder
he climbs on top of that short of length delivery and punches this supremely, finds the man at extra cover though
plenty of width outside off, the batsman crashes it to deep cover off the front foot
short ball, the batsman pulls but is not in control, places it in the gap at midwicket though
he pushes it to mid-off and calls early for a quick one
Unmukt cuts out a probably boundary at point! Width from Cutting again and Mayank punches it stylishly off the back foot, but Unmukt dives to his right to cut it off
and more runs, now he bowls it wide outside off and this has been smartly placed in the tiny gap between short third man and point
not a good start with the ball either, he bowls a length delivery on the pads and that is tickled to the fine-leg boundary
he stands tall and punches it on the up, but straight to cover
length delivery outside off, KP lets it go

dropped by Cutting at fine leg! Things have not gone well for him since that six!. The batsman gets a thick top-edge as he goes for the pull and Cutting moves to his left to get under the ball comfortably, but drops a sitter
that is superb start from Mayank! Everyone has been hit by the Uthappa bug. It's a length ball and Mayank punches it over cover with the straightest of bats..
he walks across the stumps and whips the length ball from outside off to deep midwicket
good start by the bowler, it's a length ball in the channel and it drifts away, KP lets it go
